sections.title: Advanced Programming
sections.description: The goals of this course are twofold: (1) to take good programmers and turn them into excellent ones, and (2) to introduce them to a range of modern software engineering practices, in particular those embodied in advanced functional programming languages. Four courses involving significant programming and a discrete mathematics or modern algebra course. Enrollment by permission of the instructor only.
